reason: I only have Saturdays with my toddler, so an unlimited membership would get maybe 3 or 4 visits a month at best, and it's a drive for us and gas adds up. The free library storytime already covers my weekday outing.
objection: I work full time and only get weekends, so I'd be paying $59 a month for a handful of Saturday visits plus the drive. I can't tell it beats the free stuff I already do.
would_change_my_mind: Weekend hours that are reliably open and not packed, and a cheaper weekends-only membership or a drop-in pass bundle that makes the drive worth it.
